verdict_A_reason: The published server endpoint, hosted strict release gate, manual Records run, and signed-in/guest browser flow have not yet been independently observed in this review. Source and unit evidence cannot establish a live outcome.
source_findings: Records has no browser handler; SERVER_CATALOG supplies a server reference to manual Tools and category discovery, and fa0a78ab keeps the strict catalog gate scoped to CANONICAL_SURFACE.

The strict catalog gate reads the authenticated server detail and rejects missing server routing, active native binding, DB-versus-generated Records action variants, incomplete full execution schema, and an unverified server validator verdict. The server test asserts 25 schema variants and exercises missing-action and missing-binding failures.

The release helper signs in at the configured Supabase project, checks membership in the explicitly configured organization, and passes the resulting JWT only to its release child environment; the workflow points at the API base path. No static or printed bearer token was found in the reviewed source.

The new full-command fixtures exercise clean, unreachable, and drifted server responses, but use a one-action synthetic Records schema. The aidream test and pending live gate carry the 25-action proof.
remaining_requirements: Observe aidream deployment of the execution_contract endpoint and its selected CI proof.
Observe the hosted release strict gate pass against the live DB and server with point-use identity and explicit organization.
Observe manual Records and signed-in/guest browser behavior in the deployed extension.
